danger_horse.name: Ensign Parker
danger_horse.reason: Ran a solid 3rd at Scone over 6f last start. Holds a very strong wet track profile (14 wet runs for 5 placings) and gets claim relief.

danger_horse.name: Enniroc
danger_horse.reason: Flagged as the danger horse. Won a Grafton Cl3 two starts back on soft ground and drops to 121lbs with Grant Buckley in the saddle. Sneaks into the field as an emergency and can finish hard off a strong speed. | 📏 Sprint to Sprint

danger_horse.name: Sunday
danger_horse.reason: Proven 1400m specialist who was narrowly beaten by a nose at Dubbo in Benchmark 58 company two starts back. Fits the danger horse profile as a high-upside closer who thrives on Central West tracks.

danger_horse.name: Nomorenightshift
danger_horse.reason: High-upside 5yo gelding who caught the eye finishing off stoutly in a stacked Muswellbrook Bm87 sprint first-up. Placed in Sydney Midweek Bm72 grade last campaign and gets key jockey Braith Nock at 55kg. | 🔻 Class Drop

danger_horse.name: Restless Spirit
danger_horse.reason: First-up from a spell after last competing in the Group 3 Black Opal Stakes ($142k) in March. Massive class drop down to Country Showcase Maiden company ($34k). Class Drop Elevator applied with a +10 point class adjustment. Late rider alteration to Damon Budler. Primary danger horse in the field. | 🔻 Class Drop

danger_horse.name: Torpedo Ted
danger_horse.reason: Dangerous route horse stepping back out to 1m third-up. Ran a peak speed rating of 69 when finishing 2nd over 1 1/8m on a heavy track last campaign. Live value closer if pace is genuine. | 📏 Sprint to Route

danger_horse.name: Speed Of Thought
danger_horse.reason: Fitter second-up after pressing the tempo and finishing 4th at Wagga over 5f on heavy ground. Previously placed 3rd over this exact Forbes track and distance in similar showcase company. | 📏 Sprint to Sprint

danger_horse.name: Western Warrior
danger_horse.reason: Unbeaten 1st-up record (2 for 2) returning from a break. Won a Dubbo BM58 fresh last preparation and possesses a sharp turn of foot. | 📏 Route to Sprint

danger_horse.name: Bulla Vinaka
danger_horse.reason: Dangerous closer dropping back to country Class 1 company after sound Wagga Benchmark 50 runs. Well-weighted at 55kg from barrier 5.

danger_horse.name: Atmospheric Rock
danger_horse.reason: In peak racing condition after back-to-back placings in Canberra Acton Open company, including a narrow 2nd on July 24. Carries a ideal 56.7kg weight load and possesses a lethal closing sprint that makes him the main threat if early tempo is solid.

danger_horse.name: Acheson
danger_horse.reason: Dangerous country dropper for Keith Dryden coming off a narrow 2nd in the Narrandera Cup over 1600m. Benefits from a 2kg apprentice claim and barrier 3 geometry to settle near the speed into the short 350m home straight.

danger_horse.name: Cheap Shot
danger_horse.reason: Flagged as the danger horse. Form is rock solid with consecutive 3rd-place finishes in Dubbo BM58 company over 1400m and 1200m. Possesses a strong turn of foot to sweep late. | ⚠️ Wide Trip

danger_horse.name: Lyco Reco
danger_horse.reason: Dominant track-and-distance winner two starts back over 2100m on Soft track carrying 119 lbs. Fresh off a 31-day let-up and stays in very light at the weights. Dangerous if allowed to dictate or sit just off the lead.

danger_horse.name: Tsuyoi Kitsune
danger_horse.reason: Resuming 3yo who dropped out of the $88k Listed Elwick Stakes on debut as a 2yo. Returns off two slick Hobart trial performances (won July 6 trial, 2nd July 20 trial). High upside upside runner dropping heavily in grade. | 🔻 Class Drop

danger_horse.name: Verbano
danger_horse.reason: Dangerous longshot closer dropping back from Open grade. Ran a narrow 2nd to Fighting Floyd over this track and trip on June 21 and gains key rail positioning from barrier 1 to charge late up the uphill straight. | 🔻 Class Drop

danger_horse.name: Royal Detective
danger_horse.reason: Main danger. Fits the Hobart home straight profile perfectly as a strong late closer. Beaten under 1.5 lengths in a competitive Class 2 last start and previously won at this track. Well suited dropping back slightly in distance.

danger_horse.name: Daytona Diva
danger_horse.reason: Highly talented 4yo mare possessing an extraordinary Hobart track record with 5 wins from 7 starts. Drops to featherweight 119 lbs (54kg) from barrier 2 with tactical speed to control the race. | 📏 Sprint to Sprint

danger_horse.name: Billie The Great
danger_horse.reason: In career-best form with 1 win and 2 seconds from her last 4 outings, including a nose second in BM68 company over 1200m on June 7. Carries a featherweight of 119lbs from stall 3 and handles wet track conditions well.

danger_horse.name: Them's The Breaks
danger_horse.reason: Finished a solid third behind Don Turboas over this track and distance on July 19. Proven stayer dropping back in distance, which suits the Hobart uphill stamina test perfectly.

danger_horse.name: Henley Extreme
danger_horse.reason: Primary danger horse. Shows strong late closing sectionals and returns to 1600m at Hobart where she previously won by 3.8 lengths.

danger_horse.name: Hububbajahn
danger_horse.reason: High upside mare coming off a narrow nose 2nd in Class 4 company on the synthetic track. Has extensive Hobart experience (14: 1-5-3) and gets elite local jockey Anthony Darmanin from barrier 2.

danger_horse.name: Just My Lot
danger_horse.reason: Resuming from a spell for the Tom Dabernig yard. Holds superior overall class experience including close runner-up finishes at Kyneton and Casterton prior to contesting stakes company in Tasmania. Winning trial performance indicates she is well primed.

danger_horse.name: Specky Boy
danger_horse.reason: Western District wet-track specialist with multiple placings on heavy tracks, including prior placings over Hamilton circuit. Drawn inside stall 1 to save ground along the rail.

danger_horse.name: Devoted To You
danger_horse.reason: Major weight relief angle dropping from 149lb (67.5kg) in highweight staying maidens down to 127lb (57.5kg) set weights today. Proven wet track stayer who will benefit greatly from the 22lb weight drop.

danger_horse.name: Irlandais
danger_horse.reason: Extreme wet track specialist with 6 placings from 7 career starts on Heavy ground. Comes off a strong runner-up effort at Naracoorte in 0-56 company over 2000m on rain-affected turf. | 📏 Route to Route

danger_horse.name: Kawhia
danger_horse.reason: Proven Western District wet-track stamina specialist with 13 starts on heavy ground yielding a victory and 4 placings. Recorded a narrow 2nd over the Hamilton 1600m in soft/heavy conditions earlier this campaign. Returning from a hurdle trial run, he represents a high-upside danger if the track severely deteriorates.

danger_horse.name: On The Map
danger_horse.reason: Dangerous closer dropping back into Vic Country 0-56 grade following a 42-day let-up. Holds strong wet track stats and gets useful weight relief carrying 56kg.

danger_horse.name: The Last Judgement
danger_horse.reason: Proven wet tracker with 4 starts on heavy going resulting in 1 win and 2 seconds. Ran a close 2nd behind top choice Rockcliff on heavy going at Donald three starts back and gets a crucial 54kg featherweight advantage today.
